Dear Mr. Pace,

Re: Statute of Limitations Dispute

We acknowledge receipt of your dispute regarding the statute of limitations for the account referenced above, ACC-638009. We understand that you are disputing the debt based on the statute of limitations.

Pursuant to the Fair Debt Collection Practices Act (FDCPA) and Wyoming state law, we must investigate your dispute. We will review the account history to determine the validity of your claim. We will also verify the original creditor, Cornerstone Community Bank, and the charge-off date of 2024-05-19.

We will investigate the charge-off date and the last payment date of 2024-05-09 to determine if the debt is indeed past the statute of limitations. We will also review the current balance of $2,272.89.

Regarding your request for validation, we confirm that we are a legitimate debt collector and have a legitimate interest in collecting the debt. However, we will provide you with a validation notice in accordance with the FDCPA, which includes the amount of the debt, the name of the creditor, and a statement that unless you dispute the validity of this debt or any portion thereof, we will assume the debt to be valid.

Please note that this letter is not a demand for payment. We will not engage in any further collection activities until we have completed our investigation.

You have the right to dispute this debt further if you believe it is inaccurate or not owed. If you wish to dispute the debt, please respond to this letter within 30 days.

Sincerely,

Allied Recovery Services
